messages:
jun: opened PR to swap console observability samples to SDK v2; includes dashboard JSON, tracing hook examples (node/python), and updated cost/latency copy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2277 :clipboard:

nina: thanks. can someone verify the legend behavior on narrow screens? previous migrate caused clipping.

ben: i'll run a quick responsive check. also, did you keep legacy metric keys so existing dashboards don't break?

jun: yes, legacy keys preserved. added a migration note about the new `cost_key` powering the breakdown widget.

docs-bot: Link scan: /sdk/node/tracing -> redirect added in branch. Lint: ok. Preview build completed.

ira: copy nit: replace "per-token" with `token_units` to match billing metric.

nina: responsive test: legend wraps at 340px. option A: move legend under chart, B: make legend collapsible toggle. Thoughts?

ben: prefer collapsible toggle but must be keyboard accessible. i'll add ARIA attributes if we change JSON.

jun: also, samir mentioned node snippet still used old tracing signature in a comment earlier; pls update to new Tracing.start(...) shape and python context manager example.

ben: updated snippets in branch and added small ARIA snippet for legend: `{ "legend": { "mode": "toggle", "ariaLabel": "Toggle legend" } }`. tested locally.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2277  checks passed.

jun: final checklist before merge: responsive legend toggle (ben), copy uses `token_units` (ira), snippets SDK v2 (ben), redirects in place (docs-bot).

nina: e2e rendering on staging in 10m.

ben: e2e passed; one tiny CSS gap at 375px fixed and pushed.

jun: merging after quick legal sign-off. thanks everyone! :tada:

ira: approved. merged. will monitor the cost widget metrics and open rollback plan if necessary.
